caption: St. Peter's Basilica, Vatican City

description: The view stands in the middle of St. Peter's Square looking straight at the basilica. The Vatican obelisk rises in the center foreground, with the colonnades curving away to the left and right, their rooftop statues silhouetted against the sky. The basilica's broad façade fills the middle ground and the great dome crowns it behind. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 16:00 Europe/Rome: bright afternoon daylight with long soft shadows crossing the empty piazza.
